description: Source code implementing TCP server functionality for an echo server, including socket creation, connection handling, data processing, and thread management within Zephyr RTOS.

methods.name: sendall
methods.description: Sends all data in buffer over socket, handling partial sends.

methods.name: start_tcp_proto
methods.description: Creates, configures, binds, and listens on a TCP socket, with optional TLS support.

methods.name: handle_data
methods.description: Handles data reception and response for a TCP connection, running in a thread.

methods.name: get_free_slot
methods.description: Finds an available slot for a new connection.

methods.name: process_tcp
methods.description: Accepts incoming TCP connections and assigns handlers based on IP version.

methods.name: process_tcp4
methods.description: Main loop for handling IPv4 TCP server operations.

methods.name: process_tcp6
methods.description: Main loop for handling IPv6 TCP server operations.

methods.name: start_tcp
methods.description: Initializes and starts TCP server threads for IPv4 and IPv6.

methods.name: stop_tcp
methods.description: Stops TCP server threads and closes sockets.
